title.en: The prototype in the users’ hands

aim.sr: Na kraju časa tvoj prototip ima zapis: fotografisan je redom, probala ga je korisnica u udruženju, i ono što si tom prilikom video upisano je kao nalaz, a ne kao utisak.
aim.en: By the end of the session your prototype carries a record: it was photographed in order, a user at the association tried it, and what you saw is written down as a finding, not an impression.

bring.sr: Prototip — doneti ga je ono što se evidentira. Ko ga nije doneo, zaveden je kao prisutan sa onim što je najavio.
bring.en: The prototype — bringing it is what gets recorded. Whoever did not bring one is recorded as present with what they announced.

bring.sr: Naziv rada. Zapis bez naziva ostaje otvoren dok se naziv ne javi.
bring.en: The work’s title. An entry without a title stays open until the title is supplied.

bring.sr: Spremnost da prototip neko drugi uzme u ruke: test u udruženju je deo časa, ne dodatak.
bring.en: Readiness for someone else to pick the prototype up: the test at the association is part of the class, not an extra.

items.sr: Nastavak rada na prototipovima: razrada, dokumentovanje i testiranje. Zavedeno 27 prisustava, 21 rad fotografisan, ukupno 87 fotografija.
items.en: The prototype work continued: development, documentation and testing. 27 attendances recorded, 21 works photographed, 87 photographs in all.

items.sr: Posle prototipova — udruženje: prototipi su tamo dalje razrađivani, dokumentovani i testirani sa korisnicima.
items.en: After the prototypes — the association: there the prototypes were developed further, documented and tested with users.

items.sr: Šest zapisa nosi prisustvo bez fotografija; stoje u delu „Šta se čeka”, sa onim što je za svaki najavljeno.
items.en: Six entries carry attendance without photographs; they stand in the „What we wait for” part, each with what it announced.

items.sr: Tri ispravke ranijih zapisa trećeg časa su zavedene sa izvorom; pogođene fotografije stoje povučene iz galerije dok se ne razdvoje.
items.en: Three corrections to earlier third-class records were filed with their source; the affected photographs stay withdrawn from the gallery until they are separated.

items.sr: Fotografije su još na telefonu nastavnika — nisu prenete; strana spiska i registar radova ih čekaju.
items.en: The photographs are still on the teacher’s phone — not yet transferred; the list page and the work register wait for them.

items.sr: Poseta udruženju istog dana: sedamnaest zavedenih imena u zasebnom registru; jedno ime je na poseti a nije u spisku radova.
items.en: The association visit the same day: seventeen names recorded in a separate register; one name is on the visit but not in the list of works.

items.sr: Pet otvorenih pitanja zatvoreno je uz izvor; „brza putanja” je uslovno pripisana i čeka potvrdu studentkinje.
items.en: Five open questions were closed with their source; „brza putanja” is provisionally attributed and awaits the student’s confirmation.

items.sr: Granica evidencije: prisustvo na predavanju do sada nije vođeno, pa se „bio a nije zaveden” iz spiskova ne vidi.
items.en: A limit of the record: attendance at the lecture has not been kept, so „present but not recorded” is not visible from the lists.

text.sr: Nedelja 4 — spisak radova četvrtog časa: 27 zavedenih prisustava, 21 fotografisan rad, deo „Šta se čeka” i ispravke ranijih zapisa
text.en: Week 4 — the list of the fourth class: 27 recorded attendances, 21 photographed works, the „What we wait for” part and the corrections to earlier records
A regulation is not a recommendation

We cross-check measurements against the Rulebook on technical standards of accessibility (Official Gazette RS 22/2015 and 10/2026). Every element gets its article number, required standard, and compliance verdict. Where the regulation is silent, we mark it as 'not regulated'.
text.sr: Upoređujemo izmerene vrednosti sa Pravilnikom o tehničkim standardima pristupačnosti („Sl. glasnik RS” 22/2015 i 10/2026). Za svaki element navodimo broj člana, propisani zahtev i ocenu usklađenosti. Gde propis ćuti, upisujemo „nije propisano”.

items.en: Art. 7 — Ramps: gradient max 5 % (1:20), exceptionally 8,3 % (1:12) up to 6 m; clear width min 120 cm; landings every 6 m.
items.sr: Čl. 7 — Rampe: nagib najviše 5 % (1:20), izuzetno 8,3 % (1:12) do 6 m; svetla širina najmanje 120 cm; odmorišta na svakih 6 m.

items.en: Art. 14 — Corridors: min 180 cm for two-way passing, min 90 cm for one-way.
items.sr: Čl. 14 — Hodnici: najmanje 180 cm za dvosmerno kretanje, najmanje 90 cm za jednosmerno.

items.en: Art. 17 — Doors: clear passage min 80 cm; min 90 cm where approach requires a turn.
items.sr: Čl. 17 — Vrata: svetla širina najmanje 80 cm; najmanje 90 cm gde pristup zahteva skretanje.

items.en: Art. 18 — Thresholds: max 2 cm with bevelled or rounded edges.
items.sr: Čl. 18 — Pragovi: najviše 2 cm sa zaobljenim ili zakošenim ivicama.

items.en: Art. 19 — Maneuvering space: turning circle diameter min 150 cm without obstacles.
items.sr: Čl. 19 — Manevarski prostor: krug okretanja prečnika najmanje 150 cm bez prepreka.

items.en: Which measured dimension differed most from what the law requires, and why do you think it was built that way?
items.sr: Koja izmerena dimenzija najviše odstupa od zakonskog zahteva i šta misliš zašto je tako izvedena?

sta.sr: Nedelja 4 je održana kao nastavak rada na prototipovima i testiranja u udruženju. Pripremljena tema „Pravilnik naspram tvog crteža” nije održana tog dana; njeni blokovi ostaju na strani, ispod zapisa sa časa, i čekaju nedelju u kojoj se stvarno drže.
sta.en: Week 4 was held as a continuation of the prototype work and the testing at the association. The prepared theme „The Rulebook against your own drawing” was not held that day; its blocks remain on the page, below the record of the class, and wait for the week in which they are actually taught.

sta.sr: Dopuna zapisa četvrtog časa: spisak sa posete udruženju zaveden je kao zaseban registar, pet otvorenih pitanja je zatvoreno, a nevođena evidencija prisustva na predavanju upisana je kao granica evidencije, ne kao propust koji se krije.
sta.en: An addition to the record of the fourth class: the association-visit list is filed as its own register, five open questions are closed, and the fact that lecture attendance has not been kept is written down as a limit of the record, not a gap to be hidden.
